name: VoidkitDisplay
description:
Everything that faces the player: presentation and interaction.

  motd         server list MOTD, with rotation across multiple variants
  tab          tab list header and footer
  scoreboard   per-player sidebar, switchable by permission group
  chat-format  chat layout, player-name hover card, click actions
  announce     manual broadcasts plus a rotating auto-broadcast
  menu         JSON-driven chest menus (the classic "clock menu")

All of them share one small inline markup DSL for colour codes, placeholders and clickable actions.

Note that the vanilla protocol limits what is possible: scoreboard lines are plain strings and the server list entry does not accept click events, so those two cannot have clickable or hovering text.

This jar also contains the title module - it is not a separate mod.

Every module here can be toggled individually via the `features` config.
Requires voidkit_core. Server-side only.
